summary.value: Anthropic reported a campaign in which a jailbroken Claude Code agent handled much of the tactical intrusion workflow, including reconnaissance, vulnerability discovery, exploitation, credential collection, and data analysis.

agentic_classification.value: Agentic campaign with human stage gates

observed_outcome.value: Anthropic reported a small number of successful intrusions and estimated the agent performed 80-90% of campaign activity, with human operators retaining several critical decision points.

attribution_note.value: Anthropic assessed the group as Chinese state-sponsored with high confidence; retain that as an attributed vendor assessment rather than an independent project conclusion.
